name: WERK impact measurement and feedback contract
purpose: Version-bind a WERK reform/impact-map baseline, a real implementation event, KPI observations and review-only improvement hypotheses without converting correlation into causation or automatically adopting a policy change.

prerequisites.authoritative_reform_model: Existing WERK reform/model IDs and artifact refs must be reused; no parallel fiscal model.
prerequisites.implementation_event: Observed impact must never be claimed before a source-bound implementation event exists.

separation_rules: observed value is not causal attribution
deviation is arithmetic in one declared unit, not proof of policy effect
attribution hypothesis remains explicitly unverified until separately evidenced
improvement hypothesis is review material, never an automatic policy decision

storage_contract.transport_boundary: trusted service_role; reviewer RPCs require active impact_reviewer

snapshot_semantics.deviation_from_baseline: observed_value - baseline_value in the same declared unit
snapshot_semantics.deviation_from_target: only if target_value is explicitly present; arithmetic only

review_contract.boundary: review-only; no automatic implementation, recommendation ranking, acceptance or rejection

negative_guards: observation cannot be recorded without a measurement plan
unit cannot silently change between a plan and an observation
snapshot never labels arithmetic deviation as causal effect
no automatic adoption of improvement hypothesis

tests: invalid observation period and missing plan fail closed

acceptance_boundary: Builder evidence proves the bounded staging measurement contract only. No real reform implementation or observed causal policy effect is claimed. Independent Supervisor countercheck remains required.
